source_text: The debates centered on whether circumcision—symbolizing full incorporation into the Mosaic covenant—was requisite for Gentile salvation and church membership, with Judaizers, identified as believing Pharisees, arguing affirmatively that "it was necessary to circumcise them and to direct them to observe the law of Moses." [36] [34]
